**Profile + version**

- hermes-router version (`grep version plugin.yaml`):
- Hermes Agent version / profile count:

**What happened** (what the agent did vs. what you expected)

**Route log excerpt** (`/tmp/uncensored-router-<profile>.log`, the

**Delivered turn** (the visible reply — was there a banner? a marker?
a duplicated or truncated answer?)

**Config block** (`hermes_router:` section of the profile config.yaml)

**Repro** (the turn text or a minimal equivalent)
